newsitem.title: USA: Sept U.S. MTBE stocks off 10.6 percent to 8.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Sept U.S. MTBE stocks off 10.6 percent to 8.3 mln.

text.p: U.S. inventories of MTBE fell in September by 10.6 percent to 8.36 million barrels amid stocks drops in the East, West and Gulf Coasts, according to U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) data.

The report, released recently by the DOE's U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), also said output of MTBE (methyl tertiary butyl ether) rose by about 3.91 percent to 186,000 barrels per day (bpd).
Stocks in the key U.S. Gulf output region fell by 2.08 percent or 73,000 barrels to 3.43 million barrels, while USG output rose 3.8 percent to 164,000 barrels in September.

East Coast inventories eased 28,000 barrels to 1.29 million barrels. Output in the key consumption region, where reformulated gasoline use is concentrated, was not provided in order to protect individual company data, EIA said.
West Coast inventories fell 21.7 percent to 3.35 million barrels, with output data in the region also withheld to protect individual company data.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk 212 859 1631
